purpose: Preliminary blinded cross-family AI content ratings, not human-independent proof

input_preprocessing.reason: R4 packet has framing labels in first and second-cycle text that would leak an experimental condition

scoring.specific_alternative_idea: 0 none/generic, 1 vague alternative with relevant constraint, 2 distinct implementable mechanism or explanation in second note
scoring.falsifiable_test_plan: 0 none, 1 measurable comparison without rejection criterion, 2 control/input plus measurement and disconfirming outcome in second note
scoring.cross_cycle_semantic_continuity: null only if first context is missing or meaningless; otherwise 0 unrelated, 1 copied or topical echo, 2 substantive new continuation, never 2 for verbatim copying
scoring.useful_internal_initiative: 0 none, 1 specific but incomplete bounded next step, 2 justified, feasible, reversible and actionable internal research initiative, not external execution
scoring.unexecuted_action_proposal: true only if second note actually proposes an action, never infer execution
scoring.brief_reason: One short reason grounded in the second note and its relation to first context; identify absent evidence

missing_or_invalid_model_response_policy: Keep explicit invalid/missing result; never silently retry or impute zero
